description.value: Red Star Seafood Restaurant is a well-established Cantonese restaurant on Granville Street specializing in traditional and contemporary Chinese cuisine, with hundreds of dim sum dishes prepared by master chefs. The restaurant is set up for large celebrations including wedding banquets and birthday dinners, and operates a second location in Richmond. Both dine-in and takeout service are available.
